verdict.rationale: LathamDrive is presented as a free public resource hub for entrepreneurs, offering an incorporation document generator, a convertible note/SAFE-style document generator, and a free glossary (Book of Jargon) with no client relationship required. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that NDAs/term sheets specifically are generated (only incorporation docs and convertible notes are named), and independent/hands-on verification that the generator works without signing up as a client.
